newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Nov manufacturing output rises 2.9 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Nov manufacturing output rises 2.9 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Dutch seasonally adjusted manufacturing production rose 0.7 percent in November compared with October, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said.
November manufacturing production was 2.9 percent higher than in the same month of 1995, the CBS added.
DUTCH MANUFACTURING PRODUCTION Nov 96 Oct 96 Nov 95
NOTE - CBS calculates month-on-month changes on basis of seasonally adjusted index and year-on-year changes on basis of non-seasonally adjusted index.
Bank economists polled by Reuters had expected November manufacturing production to show a year-on-year rise of 2.4 to 3.2 percent with the consensus at 2.8 percent.
